narrative.overview: RepoDeck is engineered as a high-density, tactile developer cockpit. It rejects decorative SaaS fluff in favor of razor-sharp data presentation, sub-millisecond tactile feedback, and seamless dual-world theming.

rules.name: The Color-as-Data Rule
rules.body: Color is never applied merely for decoration. Every hue communicates explicit semantic state.

rules.name: The Monospace-for-Numbers Rule
rules.body: All numeric counters must render in Space Mono or tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat and tonal at rest.

dos: Do maintain tabular monospace alignment for all numbers and dates.
Do keep table row heights compact (52px) for maximum visible information density.
Do provide instant keyboard shortcuts for navigation and search.
donts: Don't add soft, blurry gradient drop-shadows that degrade technical scanability.
Don't use slow animations; all transitions must complete in under 150ms.
Don't hide critical repository metrics behind extra clicks.
